document: MealUp — C6.2 Asset Registration Status Ledger
purpose: Track the distinction between planned, generated, reviewed, approved, and repository-registered assets.

status_definitions.QUEUED: Planned by the validated C6 queue; no repository asset file verified.
status_definitions.GENERATED_UNREGISTERED: Asset was generated/seen in ChatGPT, but the binary file is not currently available to register in GitHub.
status_definitions.REVIEWED: Binary asset is available and has passed visual review, but approval/registration is not yet complete.
status_definitions.APPROVED: Binary asset is explicitly approved for use.
status_definitions.REGISTERED: Approved binary asset and metadata are committed to the repository.

OLIVE.evidence: Approved production brief C6.2-B01 and prior ChatGPT generation; binary asset not currently exposed as a file in the repository/file workspace.
OLIVE.next_action: When the binary image is available, review against C6.2-B01 and register under assets/food-objects/olive/.

TRUFFLE.next_action: When the binary image is available, review against the approved visual direction and register under assets/food-objects/truffle/.

BEVERAGE_BOTTLE.next_action: Map each generated bottle variant to the queue variant_id before registration.

remaining_queue_status.note: This is a planning status, not a claim that 186 images are missing if previously generated assets become available for verification.

registration_rule: Never mark an asset REGISTERED without an actual binary asset file plus metadata committed to GitHub.
